Parliament No:8
Session No:2
Volume No:64
Sitting No:6
Sitting Date:17-03-1995
Section Name:BUDGET
Title:BUDGET, MINISTRY OF INFORMATION AND THE ARTS
MPs Speaking:BG George Yong-Boon Yeo (Minister for Information and the Arts); Dr Ahmad Mattar; Dr Kanwaljit Soin; Dr Ker Sin Tze; Dr Koh Lip Lin; Dr Ow Chin Hock; Dr S. Vasoo; Mr Chin Harn Tong; Mr Choo Wee Khiang; Mr Goh Choon Kang; Mr Kenneth Chen Koon Lap; Mr Lau Ping Sum; Mr Peh Chin Hua; Mr Peter Sung; Mr Eugene Yap Giau Cheng (Mr Deputy Speaker); Mr Tan Soo Khoon (Mr Speaker);


Column: 611    The Chairman: Head R - Ministry of Information and the Arts. Amendment No. (1), Mr Peter Sung.

    The Minister for Information and the Arts (BG George Yong-Boon Yeo): Sir, I would like to thank Members who have spoken for their comments, for their compliments and, more importantly, for their criticisms.

    I was concerned by Dr Ahmad Mattar's comments on the quality of Malay broadcasts. I ought to respond to him and say that we will form a committee to see how we can improve Malay broadcasts. [Hon. Members proposed Dr Ahmad Mattar.] Of course, if Dr Ahmad Mattar is prepared to help, then we will be very happy to have his help. This is not a matter to be taken lightly.
